Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary.

We ran this past commercial and ops and have two practical paths below. I've attached a short spreadsheet that models the pricing impact and a proposed patch to the order form for each option.

Option A — Single consolidated exhibit (fast cutover)
- Combine Exhibit B + C into one Exhibit ("Consolidated Throughput").
- Reallocate SKUs 70/30 as you requested; pricing will be blended pro-rata across bands; see tab "Option A" in the attached xlsx.
- One-time migration credit = pro-rated overlap for up to 30 days.
- Billing start = original effective date for retained SKUs; migrated SKUs bill from cutover date.
- Legal touchpoints: minor order form patch + updated Exhibit table.

Option B — Phased migration with credits (lower immediate billing impact)
- Maintain separate exhibits for the next 60 days and gradually shift committed usage on a weekly cadence.
- Apply weekly credits to offset double-billing risk; total credit equals the overlap delta in the sheet's "Option B" tab.
- Implementation ops will provide a cutover schedule and rollback gate.
- Legal touchpoints: short amendment to Order Form describing credit mechanics and cadence.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Pick Option A or B (A = simpler, faster; B = lower short-term cash impact).
2) If you choose B, confirm the cadence (weekly vs bi-weekly) and the proposed cutover start date.
3) We'll put a marked-up amendment for your contracts team to review.

I've attached:
- exhibit_consolidation_options.xlsx (pricing model)
- proposed_orderform_patch.pdf (redline-ready patch to Exhibit tables)

If this looks OK, I'll loop in our legal/commercial lead (Karthik) and our legal counsel (Markus) to draft the amendment language.

Thanks — Grace

Grace / Laura — looping in Markus (legal) and adding a few internal notes so we can align a clean redline to Lumina's contracts team.

Quick legal/commercial points based on Grace's options and Lumina's ask:
- Credit mechanics: we need to be explicit about how credits are calculated (gross tokens vs billed units) and a firm cap per billing period. Suggest cap = 20% of billed spend for overlap window unless Lumina requests higher.
- Acceptance criteria: keep the original acceptance milestone language untouched; only the billing trigger for migrated SKUs changes.
- Data retention / logs: Lumina asked during the call about audit trails for migration; operations will be required to provide a migration ledger (dates, SKUs moved, effective times) as an attachment to the amendment.
- Termination/rollback: add a 7-calendar-day rollback window after cutover during which both parties can revert migrated SKUs with pro-rated billing reconciliation.

Action items:
- Laura, can you confirm whether finance is comfortable with the suggested 20% cap for credits? If not, propose the acceptable cap.
- Markus, please prepare a short amendment (tracked redline) that covers: consolidation statement, credit calculation formula, migration ledger requirement, rollback clause, and DocuSign-ready signature block.

We should aim to get a draft over to Lumina by EOD Monday (7 Sep) so they can route internally.

Thanks,
